shots.prompt: A fictional young botanist in a moss-green coat plants a silver seed in a moonlit glasshouse; a red field notebook rests by her left hand.
shots.title: Seed

shots.prompt: In the same glasshouse, the same botanist opens the red notebook as the silver seed grows into a luminous blue vine around the same clay pot.
shots.title: Bloom

shots.prompt: The same botanist raises the same clay pot; the blue vine releases three glowing moths that circle her while the open red notebook remains on the bench.
shots.title: Release
